sources.notes: Read 6 October 2026. nederlandco.org is a CivicPlus (CivicEngage) site titled 'Nederland, CO | Official Website'; www.nederlandco.gov serves the same site (a guessed /community-center path returned the CivicPlus custom 404 there). October 2026 shows six items, all under Town Board Meetings: Board of Trustees 6 and 20 Oct 7-10 pm, Downtown Development Authority 14 Oct 6-8 pm, Parks, Recreation & Open Space Advisory Board 15 Oct 5:30-7 pm, Sustainability Advisory Board 22 Oct 7-10 pm (Multipurpose Room of the Nederland Community Center) and Planning Commission 28 Oct 6-9 pm; every location is 750 Highway 72 North, Nederland CO 80466. The CivicPlus calendar RSS (feedUrl) failed with a connection error on the first attempt and read successfully on the retry: 3 items (Board of Trustees Meeting, Downtown Development Authority, Parks Recreation & Open Space Advisory Board Meeting), pubDates 18 Aug 2026 -0700, structured event dates and the 750 Highway 72 North location. The CivicPlus iCalendar endpoint with catID=14 (/common/modules/iCalendar/iCalendar.aspx?catID=14&feed=calendar) returned the Federal Holidays calendar: 47 VEVENT, 2 RRULE, 2024-11-03 to 2035-11-11, TZ America/Denver, with CivicPlus placeholder locations 'Manhattan KS 66502'; other catIDs were not probed. So the Town feed is essentially civic meetings and holidays; it is useful for the meetings section and as a Community Center venue reference, not for community events. The Town's older Colorado.gov site (townofnederland.colorado.gov/explore-nederland/event-calendar) still ranks in search but answered CloudFront 403 'Request blocked' on 6 October. sources.name: Nederland Community Library
sources.notes: Unreachable from here on 6 October 2026: two attempts to fetch https://nederlandlibrary.org/ both failed with a curl connection error before any HTTP status (likely the proxy or the host refusing the connection), so robots.txt and the calendar vendor (LibCal, LibraryCalendar, Communico or other) could not be checked. Web search snippets (townofnederland.colorado.gov press releases) place the library at 200 CO-72 (Highway 72 North), Nederland CO 80466, next to the Community Center, and mention a Summer Reading Program kickoff and a Reading Garden ribbon cutting in 2024. Keep manual until the site can be reached and a feed confirmed. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own). Corrected 6 October 2026: nederlandlibrary.org does not answer; the library’s live site is https://nederland.colibraries.org/, which the Town’s directory links. The id is kept so nothing that names it breaks. Feed found 10 November 2026: the library's site links its calendar at nederland.libcal.com (Springshare LibCal, one public calendar, id 4818, named 'Nederland Library Community Room'). Its iCal subscription, the feedUrl here, answered 200 text/calendar with 203 VEVENT from October 2026 to September 2027 and parsed with the ingest's own reader: 33 items in 10 November to 9 December and 153 from today onward. The LibCal RSS for the same calendar (https://nederland.libcal.com/rss.php?iid=3657&m=month&cid=4818, 35 items with libcal:date, start, end and location) reads too but covers only the coming month; the page's own RSS link uses cid=-1 and comes back empty. Of the 33, 7 are room bookings titled 'Reserved', 2 are closures (Thanksgiving Day, Black Friday) and 2 are NCL District Board meetings, which is what the excludeTitles added today drop; that leaves 22: Wild Bear Storytime (Tuesdays 10:30), STORYTIME! (Fridays 10:15), Monday Nederland Writers, Sci Fi Book Club (10 Nov and 8 Dec, 7 pm), After-school Makers Club, Parents Night Out (14 Nov), Philosophy Club (17 Nov), Front Range Mycological Society (18 Nov), Adult Makers Club (19 Nov), a women's support circle (1 Dec) and Peak Harmony Holiday music (3 Dec, 6:30 pm). Locations are a room ('Community Room', 'Library Open Areas') or nothing, hence the defaultVenue. Some are other groups' meetings in the library's room, not library programmes. robots.txt allows both feeds for our agent (it disallows only /process_ and asks for a ten-second crawl delay). This entry was already confirmed when the feed was found, so the next ingest will read it; the weekly storytimes and writers' group may want excluding too if the guide lists them as regulars. Left as manual on 10 November 2026 although the feed reads: the entry is already confirmed, so typing it ical would start ingest reading it before the owner has looked at the feed and its filters. Set type to ical to turn it on.

sources.name: Nederland Area Seniors (Mountain Peak Life)
sources.lastNote: The Events Calendar feed answers, but the site clock is set to UTC+0, so its times are mislabelled; the JSON reader throws on it and the iCal reads seven hours early
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. Nederland Area Seniors, the organization for older adults in the Peak to Peak region, now at mountainpeaklife.org (The Mountain-Ear's column gives the address, 303-258-0799 and info@mountainpeaklife.org); it runs lunches and events in the Senior Lounge at the Nederland Community Center, 750 Highway 72 North. WordPress with The Events Calendar: /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events answered 200 with 5 events from 10 November (total 5, one page) and /events/?ical=1 answered text/calendar with the same 5: Saturday Brown Bag Lunch and Matinee (14, 21 and 28 Nov, noon), All Ages International Folk Dancing (16 Nov, 6 pm) and 'NAS CLOSED: Happy Thanksgiving!' (23 Nov, all day). No venue, category or cost on any of them. robots.txt allows everything. Not recorded as a json source because it cannot be read correctly yet: the site's WordPress time zone is 'UTC+0', so the API labels Denver wall-clock times as UTC. The ingest's reader for this format threw 'Invalid time zone specified: UTC+0' on the page, and its iCal reader took the noon lunch for 5 am. Two ways on: the organization sets its site time zone to Denver, or the reader learns to treat 'UTC+0' on this source as local time. Until then read by hand, four or five listings a month; if it is ever switched on, exclude '^NAS CLOSED' and set defaultVenue to the Senior Lounge at the Community Center.
